name: Bootstrap Toggle
description: Field widget (and matching read-only formatter) that renders a boolean field's checkbox as a Bootstrap Toggle on/off switch, with configurable on/off labels, size, and Bootstrap contextual colours.

library_dependencies.name: bootstrap-toggle
library_dependencies.install_method: Manual download or drupal-library composer package; not bundled with the module.
library_dependencies.note: hook_requirements() raises a runtime REQUIREMENT_ERROR if bootstrap-toggle.min.js / .min.css are not found under the site's libraries directory.

provides_plugin_types: Field widget: bootstrap_toggle_switch (targets the core 'boolean' field type)
Field formatter: bootstrap_toggle_switch (targets the core 'boolean' field type; read-only, extends core BooleanFormatter)
project_description: Provides Bootstrap Toggle Button as a widget for boolean field. It exposes a 'Bootstrap Toggle' field widget (id bootstrap_toggle_switch) for core boolean fields that renders the checkbox as a sliding on/off switch via the third-party Bootstrap Toggle JavaScript library, plus a matching read-only field formatter that shows the same switch (disabled) on display. Widget/formatter settings cover the on-state and off-state labels, whether to show the field label, the button size (large/normal/small/mini), the on/off contextual Bootstrap styles (primary/success/info/warning/danger/default), and optional numeric height/width overrides. The Bootstrap Toggle library (minhur/bootstrap-toggle 2.2.2, MIT) is NOT bundled: it must be placed under the site's libraries/bootstrap_toggle directory (manual download or a drupal-library composer package), and hook_requirements reports an error until it is present. The module also assumes a Bootstrap-based theme on the form's rendering context for the switch to look correct. Maintained by Abhishek Pareek (abhishek_pareek) and Jordan Karlov (JordiK); sponsored by Innoraft Solutions.
